scope: All 100 documents; no oracle target supplied
vector: Unconfigured isolated adapter: local Tantivy/exact/read tools; no real Dify hybrid claim
selection: Same first 100 eligible test IDs as frozen phase-2 benchmark; no filtering by success
limitations: Model-assisted support judge is the same model, not human gold
Gold document identity is not evidence-span recall
Gold answer mention is not answer accuracy
MinerU and frozen PyMuPDF inputs reported separately; not fresh parsing acceptance
